# wikiHow Life

> > wikiHow Life is a comprehensive how-to platform offering step-by-step guides across academics, DIY home improvement, technical skills, cooking, wellness, and community support.

wikiHow Life provides practical, illustrated instructions for a wide range of topics from scientific writing and calculus to home repair, welding, and culinary arts. The platform combines expert-authored guides with community forums to help users learn practical skills across multiple domains.

## Key Topics

- how-to-guide
- step-by-step-guide
- scientific-writing
- academic-guide
- DIY home improvement
- technical skills
- HVAC maintenance
- welding
- cooking and recipes
- student preparation
- design prototyping
- community forums
- research publication
- citations
- troubleshooting

## Academic & Scientific Writing

- [How to Write a Scientific Paper (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Special:Randomizer): Guide to writing scientific papers with proper formatting, citations, and academic structure.
- [How to Find the Extrema of a Function: 11 Steps](https://www.wikihow.life/Find-the-Extrema-of-a-Function): Tutorial on finding extrema in calculus using derivative tests and optimization.
- [How to Survive Taking an AP Test](https://www.wikihow.life/Survive-Taking-an-AP-Test): Student guide to AP exam preparation and test-day survival strategies.

## DIY & Home Improvement

- [How to Replace Deck Railing with Prebuilt Vinyl Railing: 13 Steps](https://www.wikihow.life/Replace-Deck-Railing-with-Prebuilt-Vinyl-Railing): DIY home improvement guide for replacing deck railing with vinyl.
- [How to Clean a Trane Rooftop Unit (RTU) Condensing Coil: 12 Steps](https://www.wikihow.life/Clean-a-Trane-Rooftop-Unit-(RTU)-Condensing-Coil): HVAC maintenance guide for cleaning Trane rooftop unit condensing coils.
- [How to Test a Lawn Mower Starter: 12 Steps (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Test-a-Lawn-Mower-Starter): DIY guide to testing and troubleshooting lawn mower starter issues.

## Technical Skills & Craftsmanship

- [How to Gas Tungsten Arc Weld an Aluminum Corner Joint](https://www.wikihow.life/Gas-Tungsten-Arc-Weld-an-Aluminum-Corner-Joint): Technical guide to GTAW welding technique for aluminum corner joints.
- [How to Prototype a Design (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Prototype-a-Design): Guide to design thinking and prototyping ideas from concept to testing.
- [How to Create a Cover for a Zine: 13 Steps (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Create-a-Cover-for-a-Zine): Self-publishing guide to designing and creating zine covers.

## Cooking & Entertaining

- [How to Build a Delicious Mezze Platter: 12 Steps (with Pictures)](https://www.wikihow.life/Build-a-Delicious-Mezze-Platter): Recipe and entertaining guide for creating Mediterranean mezze platters.
- [How to Make Homemade Dunkaroos Dip: 8 Steps](https://www.wikihow.life/Make-Homemade-Dunkaroos-Dip): Recipe for homemade Dunkaroos-style dessert dip using cake mix.

## Wellness & Personal Development

- [4 Ways to Move Deeply Into the Now Through Devotion](https://www.wikihow.life/Move-Deeply-Into-the-Now-Through-Devotion): Guide to spiritual practice and mindfulness through devotional practices.

## Community Support & Forums

- [What's good mileage for a used car? - wikiHow Forums](https://www.wikihow.life/Forum/Discussion-Whats-Good-Mileage-for-a-Used-Car): Community forum discussion on used car buying and mileage considerations.
- [What are some good science expo ideas? - wikiHow Forums](https://www.wikihow.life/Forum/Discussion-What-Are-Some-Good-Science-Expo-Ideas): Community forum for science fair and expo project ideas.
- [What do I do if my bestie is growing away from me? - wikiHow Forums](https://www.wikihow.life/Forum/Discussion-What-Do-I-Do-if-My-Bestie-Is-Growing-Away-from-Me): Community forum for friendship advice and relationship concerns.
